headline: Public hearing on the sale of City-owned Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business Park.
summary: The hearing covers the sale of City-owned property, known as Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business Park. Interested parties may speak in favor of or against the sale.
items: Public hearing on the sale of City-owned property
Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business Park
location: 1st Floor Meeting Room 1-1, City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT

PUBLIC HEARING – BRISTOL, CT 
SALE OF CITY OWNED PROPERTY 
 
Notice is hereby given that in accordance with the State Statutes, the Real Estate 
Committee acting on behalf of the City Council will hold a Public Hearing on Tuesday, 
November 10, 2026 at 6:15 p.m. in 1st Floor Meeting Room 1-1, City Hall, 111 North 
Main Street, Bristol, CT. Interested parties are invited to speak in favor of or against the 
sale of property owned by the City, known as Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business 
Park. 
 
Dated at Bristol, CT this 19th day of October, 2026. 
 
 
_________________________________  
Erica Cabiya 
Town and City Clerk
